newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Santa Clara USD, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL BONDS
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to California Government Code Section 53692, that the Board of Education of the Santa Clara Unified School District, California (the

District''), invites bids for the purchase of $50,000,000 aggregate principal amount of Santa Clara Unified School District (Santa Clara County, California) General Obligation Bonds Election of 1997, Series 1997. Bids will be received at 9:35 a.m., California time, on
at the office of the financial advisor to the District, Government Financial Strategies Inc., 1228

Suite Thirteen, Sacramento, California 95814, and the sale will be awarded by the District within twenty-four (24) hours. The District may postpone the date or change the time of the sale to any subsequent date or any other time by providing notification through Munifacts News Service 24 hours prior to the scheduled date. Further information, including copies of the Prelimnary Official Statement, Official Notice of Sale and Bid Form, may be obtained from the financial advisor at the above address, or by telephone at (916) 444-5100.
